qs.q:
Read the messages. What is the main idea of each message?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.

1. I wonder what I should do to make up with Mark? We had an awful fight yesterday.
2. Mum, can you call the dentist and ask if he can see me after school? I’ve got a terrible toothache!
3. Are you free tonight? Ring Peter and me up so we can make plans for this evening.
4. The kitchen’s a mess. Can you wash the dishes and put them away before I return from work? Thanks.
5. I’ll be at Sam’s Café at 9 tonight. I can’t wait to see you!
What does Don want Clive to do?
opts: To do his homework with him.
